name: Octopus
description: Workflow and agent runtime desktop app.
author: Pipeline Contributors

scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tests/tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && npm --prefix ui run build:check && npm --prefix file-parser run build
scripts.desktop:build: npm run electron:build && npm run ui:build && npm --prefix file-parser run build
scripts.desktop:e2e: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:visible: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && PIPELINE_DESKTOP_E2E_HEADLESS=0 playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts tests/electron/electron-smoke.spec.ts --grep "@visible-window"
scripts.desktop:e2e:chat-files: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts tests/electron/chat-file-upload.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-file-grounding: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/chat-file-upload.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-file-grounding:strict: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && PIPELINE_LIVE_REQUIRE=file-grounding-codex playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/chat-file-upload.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:webshare: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts tests/electron/webshare-proxy-research.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-webshare: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/webshare-proxy-research.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-webshare:strict: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && PIPELINE_LIVE_REQUIRE=webshare-research-electron playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/webshare-proxy-research.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-web-research: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/web-researcher.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-web-research:strict: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && PIPELINE_LIVE_REQUIRE=web-researcher-electron,web-researcher-browser-use-electron playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/web-researcher.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-browser-use-cohort: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/browser-use-denied-host-cohort.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-browser-use-cohort:stri: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && PIPELINE_LIVE_BROWSER_USE_COHORT=1 PIPELINE_LIVE_REQUIRE=browser-use-denied-host-cohort playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/browser-use-denied-host-cohort.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-youtube-manual: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/youtube-manual-workflow.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-youtube-manual:strict: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && PIPELINE_LIVE_YOUTUBE_MANUAL_E2E=1 PIPELINE_LIVE_REQUIRE=youtube-manual-electron playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/youtube-manual-workflow.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:packaged: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:package && node scripts/run-packaged-electron-smoke.mjs
scripts.desktop:e2e:packaged-ocr: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:package && node scripts/run-packaged-electron-smoke.mjs tests/electron/pdf-local-ocr.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-providers: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-providers:strict: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && PIPELINE_LIVE_REQUIRE=all playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-chat-streaming: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/chat-streaming-openrouter.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:e2e:live-chat-streaming:strict: VITE_ENABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 npm run desktop:build && PIPELINE_LIVE_REQUIRE=openrouter-streaming playwright test -c playwright.electron.live.config.ts tests/electron/chat-streaming-openrouter.live.spec.ts
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run builtins:stage && npm run youtube-tools:sign && npm run youtube-tools:verify && npm run office-tools:sign && npm run office-tools:verify && electron-builder --dir && npm run youtube-tools:verify-packaged && npm run office-tools:verify-packaged
scripts.electron:build: npm run type-safety:check && node scripts/clean-electron-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/stage-runtime-assets.mjs dist-electron
scripts.test: npm run type-safety:check && npm run typecheck && npm run arch:check && npm run test:core && npm run ui:check && npm run file-parser:test
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
